eyebrow: CASS · The Haven (55+ shelter), Phoenix area · 13–14 Oct 2026 · Evergreen film
title: The Haven:
format: 16:9 only · 1920×1080 (CASS YouTube evergreen, like the Vista Colina film)
headline: The Haven is CASS's shelter for people 55 and older, and the people who live and work there say what it gives them: safety, each other and a new beginning.
story: Bessie carries it. She would not have been here without her dog, Lucy, and she fought to find a shelter that would take them both. The Haven did. What it gave her first was safety.

Around her: Nathan on who The Haven is for (130 units for people 55 and older), Nicole on a senior who just moved into her own apartment, Gabriela who loves coming to work, Barbara who met people who helped her. It ends on Bessie: <q>I love new beginnings. They make you strong.</q>
The building has to be full of people. Murals, balconies and the courtyard set the place; residents are filmed from behind unless they are on camera by choice.
do: Open on Lucy and Bessie with the hook text on screen.
Use The Haven's own B-roll and drone (13–14 Oct), people over empty walls.
Lower thirds on each first on-camera line, above the captions.
Let Bessie's lines breathe; she is the heart of the film.
End on Bessie's new-beginnings line, then a wide from the air.
dont: No downtown shelter or Vista Colina B-roll: this is The Haven only.
No resident's face except the people interviewed. Residents from behind.
No logo before the end card.

bite:3.quote: And so I know that sometimes the problem seems overwhelming, and it seems almost like it's too much for just an individual to handle. But coming together as a community, I just don't want people to get discouraged, because we see those miracles every day.
